Any switch toggle advances to u1, even when the siren is silent. Do not step onto the exit before that, because an early exit ends the episode without completing the task. Box possession, dropping, and falls do not matter for this RM, so do not detour for the box.
u1: The switch has been flipped at least once, earning the 0.1 progress reward. Current objective: go to the green exit in the bottom-right floor corner and step onto it. Further toggles are unnecessary and do not improve the RM; the siren need not be silenced again, and holding, dropping, or losing the box does not affect RM progress. Reaching the exit now advances to terminal success.
u2: Terminal success state: the switch was flipped first and the agent has now reached the exit. The 1.0 exit reward has been obtained and the episode is over; there is no further objective or useful action.
